finding.title: Promote reappearance above natural-grace expiry
finding.summary: If a Bee endpoint disappears during the FD probe but reappears before the final lstat while NaturalGraceExpired is active, the code only adds a note to that grace exception. monitor() then treats it as normal boundary expiry and may allow closure/restoration. Raise a distinct INCOMPLETE failure and retain the grace exception as its cause.
